1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said diodes are mounted on said body in a non-planar arrangement extending along the length of said columnar body__.

2. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is positioned to direct light in a direction different from the direction of light emission from said diodes without said optic element__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and said phosphor material converts at least a portion of light from said diodes to a different wavelength__.

5. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said fins are configured to provide thermal dissipation while maintaining optical access to said diodes__.

7. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Original) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Original) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode on each face is positioned at a location offset from the center of said face__.

11. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __wherein a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, and said optic element is configured to modify the light distribution pattern from said diode__.

13. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further including a voltage regulation circuit for controlling power delivery to said diodes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __by means of a lens structure having a specific refractive index profile__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said diodes are positioned at different heights along the length of said body__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __at a specific location determined by a positioning template__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/ mK.

19. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and said side walls are formed with a uniform wall thickness__.
